models_evaluated: adversarial training framework for COVID-19 prediction

links.outcome: Fairness (equalized odds) and screening performance after adversarial bias mitigation
links.effect: Adversarial training improved outcome fairness while retaining clinically effective screening performance (negative predictive values >0.98).
links.quote: Using the statistical definition of equalized odds, we show that adversarial training improves outcome fairness, while still achieving clinically-effective screening performances (negative predictive values >0.98).

unlisted_practices: adversarial training to mitigate site-specific and ethnicity bias in predictive models

screen.reason: Evaluates an algorithmic bias mitigation framework (adversarial debiasing during model training) for clinical prediction, addressing model fairness and safety, but evaluates a training/model-building algorithm rather than a health care deployment guardrail.
